MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Foco nas análises e projeções de custos de produção e venda. Identificar desvios, riscos e oportunidades através das análises “planejado vs. realizado”, gerando informações detalhadas e em tempo hábil, para suportar o processo decisório.

PARA JUNTOS ALCANÇARMOS O EXTRAORDINÁRIO, VOCÊ SERÁ RESPONSÁVEL POR:

  • Responsável pela projeção e acompanhamento dos custos de curto, médio e longo prazos, por país (Brasil, Argentina, Chile e Paraguai);
  • Elaborar bridges dos cenários financeiros de custos e disponibilização à liderança executiva da empresa;
  • Calcular impactos de FX (câmbio) e Inflação nos diversos cenários financeiros analisados;
  • Desenvolver, consolidar e analisar as informações de custos para exercícios de fechamento mensal e trimestral, Budget, Forecast e Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros departamentos nas projeções e explicações das variações (Suprimentos, Logística, Contabilidade, entre outros...);
  • Construir, manter e aprimorar modelos financeiros para realização de análises ad-hoc;
  • Responsável pela elaboração de relatórios financeiros e KPI’s estratégicos da área;
  • Responsável por apresentar análises através de documentos estruturados e com foco no resultado;

PARA JUNTOS FAZERMOS A DIFERENÇA ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ TENHA

  • Formação superiorcompleta em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office | Excel avançado (essencial);
  • Matemática Financeira;
  • Conhecimento em Custos (CPM/CPV | COGM/COGS);
  • Conhecimento em Contabilidade;
  • Conhecimento de SAP;
  • Diferencial com conhecimento em sistemas BI.

A Ball Corporation é uma empresa de oportunidades iguais. Incentivamos ativamente inscrições de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sexo, idade, etnia, fé, habilidade ou orientação.

Ao ingressar na Ball, você pertence a uma equipe de mais de 22.000 membros em todo o mundo. Nosso produtos vão desde latas de alumínio infinitamente recicláveis, copos e garrafas de aerosol, que permitem que nossos clientes tenham uma compreensão mais profunda do nosso planeta e do universo.

Senior Developer - SAP Concur Cloud Services

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

Do you want to develop products and services that impact thousands of clients and millions of users around the globe? Are you ready to play a key role in defining and implementing services and solutions that have an impact across our entire company? Do you dream of delivering excellence and driving innovation? If the answer is yes, then the Platform team, Cloud Services at SAP Concur is the place for you

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our team, you will:

  • Solve complex problems and design systems that enable best-in-class operation of SAP Concur’s cloud services and communications with our customers.
  • Develop across the full-stack on a variety of technologies including Python, Lambda, Boto client, SQS, Sceptre, Cloud Custodian, Dynamo, Docker containers, Kubernetes and AWS ECS.
  • Leverage the latest and greatest AWS Cloud technologies as you build and innovate.
  • Embrace end-to-end ownership and DevOps practices: architect, design, code, test, deploy and monitor your software in providing direct value to our customers.
  • Cooperate with and mentor other engineers and product owners in an ever-evolving, agile environment.
  • Learn, as we move fast and are unafraid to venture into the unknown.
  • Be part of a team that owns products, tools and services that help other teams deliver better software and improve our relationship with customers

In order to accomplish this, you will need:

  • A solid understanding and experience with software development principles and practices.
  • A passion for maintaining high-quality, robust and scalable services.
  • Good analytical and design skills – you should be able to think about problems broadly and deeply.
  • Attention to details and strive for excellence in the quality of code you produce.
  • A high degree of intellectual curiosity and a lack of fear for learning something new. You should be open to learning from others and also willing to help mentor and teach

WHO ARE WE?

Concur, a part of SAP, imagines the way the world should work, offering cloud-based services that make it simple to manage travel and expenses. Founded in 1993, Concur services are used by 30,000 clients representing 27 million users in more than 150 countries. Your career at SAP Concur is what you make of it. title: Property Broker - Commercial Insurance (Real Estate, Hospitality, & Leisure)
description:
Description

Provide knowledge, leadership, insight and direction for broking activities to ensure that clients’ expectations are regularly met. This role incorporates a wide level of expertise, but always assumes the broker is capable of handling accounts independently. The size and complexity of the account can vary. More experienced brokers may be responsible for training and supervising Associate Brokers. Responsible to ensure that relevant regulatory and technical standards are met. Helps drive the broking team to achieve agreed operational and financial goals and objectives.

Note that visa employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity

The Role

  • Orchestrate new business placement, renewals and alterations of existing coverage.
  • Develop, review and deliver presentations to secure new, and build on existing, relationships.
  • Review and evaluate information and analytics to assess and evaluate client risks to support the placement of client risks in the market.
  • Research and evaluate all solutions (insurance and otherwise) to identify and develop optimum risk solutions for clients.
  • Provide coverage and program design advice and expertise to client; perform needs and gap analysis to make recommendations regarding program improvements.
  • Build strong partnerships with a broad range of organizations and stakeholders in the market in order to secure optimum terms and conditions for clients.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and continuous process improvement of the Broking function.
  • Work closely with associates to stay on top of changes in the marketplace.
  • Oversee design and preparation of draft proposals; negotiate and finalize of carrier quotes, terms and conditions and coverage confirmations to ensure contract certainty.
  • Bind carrier quotes and review binders and coverage confirmations.
  • Request / Attend and participate in regular client and underwriter meetings.
  • Conduct program peer reviews.
  • Provide coaching to brokers in training.

Qualifications

The Requirements
• 5-12 years industry experience (real estate, hospitality and leisure industry experience preferred but not required)
• Insurance broker’s P&C license required
• Strong group presentation skills (written and verbal); ability to drive complex/technical conversations
• Relationship management: customer focus, collaboration, interpersonal skills, and conflict management; demonstrates shared ownership of resolution of conflicts
• Negotiation skills: carrier and client negotiation skills; can secure concessions without damaging relationships
• Business acumen: demonstrates knowledge of industries and clients, carriers, and/or markets
• Project management: ability to effectively manage and oversee small projects
• Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills; high adaptability
• Leadership skills: applies judgment in making decisions, directs and motivates others, takes lead in small groups, and promotes teamwork
This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).


Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 USD per year.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos, com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenas e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Curitiba . Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo De Trabalho

  • Presencial em Curitiba e proximidades.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Desenvolvemos líderes de excelência e, unidos por valores pautados pela ética e pelo compromisso constante com a qualidade, contribuímos para gerar confiança no mercado de capitais e em economias em todo o mundo.   • Conhecimento em SAS, Hbase, Bitbucket.

  • Acompanhar a estabilização do pipeline em produção.
  • Sustentação pós-implantação (período de garantia de 90 dias).
  • Construir pipelines de dados, desde a extração até a ingestão e estruturação no Data Lake e DB2.

Full-Stack Engineer, Trust & Safety - Brazil

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Team

DoorDash is looking for Full Stack Engineers to join our Trust & Safety team. This dedicated group is entrusted with empowering both external DoorDash customers and internal users through a comprehensive catalog of Trust and Safety features, focusing on authenticity, eligibility, compliance, and beyond.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will collaborate closely with other high caliber engineers within an international team and cross-functional stakeholders to propel the group forward. Leveraging latest technological advancements, including Gen AI, you will build best-in-class Trust and Safety experience on one of the largest gig platforms in the world.

About the Role

Fullstack Engineers at DoorDash help design and build beautiful, intuitive user interfaces for our web applications as well as elegant backend APIs and services to create the best delivery experience possible. Product focused Engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You’ll work with both technical and business teams to build features that keep our users top of mind.

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Become a product owner for one of our client facing applications.
  • Write robust, highly tested, well-crafted code that you can be proud of.
  • Fight for the best customer experience through technical and product decisions.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • B.S., M.S. or PhD in relevant field
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • Experience architecting large-scale frontend applications
  • Mastery of the foundations of the web: vanilla JS, HTML5, CSS3
  • Deep understanding of REST principles and experience working with and implementing backend APIs and services
  • Experience with React/Redux, or similar frameworks
  • Experience with documentation, unit and integration testing

We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  1. diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  2. realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  3. avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  4. programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  5. ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  6. realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe/ Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista.

Especialista em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência em Oftalmologia, com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

RQE ativo

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (SRE)
description:
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

Digibee is looking to hire experienced and motivated Cloud Engineers with cloud computing and Kubernetes expertise. As a Cloud Engineer responsible for all the platform stack, you will modernize, maintain, and implement our Platform features.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Design, implement, and manage all the Kubernetes clusters of our SaaS Cloud Platform.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with Kubernetes environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes Network and computer networks in general.
  • Develop automation scripts and tools for deploying and managing Kubernetes Network and traditional cloud infrastructure.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior cloud engineers and DevOps team members.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to increase our platform solutions portfolio.

What you’ll need to bring…

  • Strong Information Security and Linux System administration fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like ContainerD and Docker.
  • Experience in Computer Networks - Load Balancer, TCP, VPN, Routing, Virtual Networks, MPLS, Firewall.
  • Experience with Cloud Platforms like AWS and GCP.
  • Good grasp on DevOps.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

It's a plus if you have…

  • Relevant certifications in Kubernetes and cloud platforms, such as CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Experience with container orchestration solutions like Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, or Google Kubernetes Engine
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools, such as GitLab CI, FluxCD

Our perks and benefits

  • We’re remote first, with a flexible working schedule
  • Health care and Odonto Plan
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education)
  • Life insurance
  • Child care assistance
  • Gympass
  • MacBook setup to work
  • English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly
  • Equity Program (RSUs)

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work remotely in the country where this job posting is located. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities

  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process

  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the role

The challenge of our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. Our mission is to understand the company’s performance from a financial perspective by analyzing past results and creating projections for the future. Broadly speaking, our team is divided into FP&A Horizontals, FP&A Markets, FP&A Global Products, FP&A Efficiency, and Procurement.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyzing, explaining, and forecasting the financial results of the Credit Card Business Unit;
• Improving FP&A processes to generate insights and clarity in income statements, always thinking in a scalable way with reliable data;
• Understanding and analyzing the impacts of product-related decisions on the results of the Business Unit (BU);
• Automating reports by connecting them with databases from different sources;
• Building, updating, and reviewing financial models and simulators;
• Creating and presenting executive materials with financial results to the Business Unit and Leadership team.

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience in financial analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet), credit analysis, or related areas;
• Has strong analytical skills to manage and evaluate complex data;
• Possesses strong communication skills to proactively engage with different business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets);
• Has advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets;
• Is fluent in English;
• Programming knowledge (Scala, SQL, and Python) is a plus.

title: Analista de Riscos
description:
Sobre nós

O Grupo Swile é um grupo multinacional francês pioneiro em benefícios flexíveis no Brasil. A nossa missão é ajudar a oferecer um melhor ambiente de trabalho para os seus colaboradores através dos benefícios flexíveis Swile que entregamos por meio de uma tecnologia de ponta.

Temos no grupo uma Instituição de Pagamento recém autorizada a funcionar pelo Banco Central do Brasil, e estamos em busca de novos integrantes para nosso time de Compliance, Controles Internos e Riscos.

Sobre a posição

  1. Criar métricas de avaliação de risco, incluindo baixo, médio e alto, partindo do zero;
  2. Gestão contínua do capital (controle de segundo nível);
  3. Monitorar os ativos ponderados pelo risco (RWA) e o Capital Regulatório (PR) (controle de segundo nível);
  4. Submeter documentos de risco ao Bacen;
  5. Criar a Declaração de Apetite ao Risco (RAS);
  6. Identificar, medir, avaliar, monitorar, reportar, controlar e mitigar riscos de crédito, operacionais, de liquidez, sociais, ambientais e climáticos;
  7. Criar políticas para rotinas da área, partindo do zero;
  8. Avaliar a criação de novos produtos ou serviços, bem como alterações ou manutenção dos produtos existentes;
  9. Criar testes de estresse;
  10. Elaborar um relatório anual sobre Riscos, inclusive operacional, a ser divulgado a Diretoria, Auditoria Interna e Externa;
  11. Elaborar o relatório do Pilar 3, incluindo a publicação no site;
  12. Criar o plano de continuidade de negócios com a equipe de Tecnologia e Produtos.

Requisitos

  1. Formação superior em Administração, Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Inglês avançado;
  3. Experiência prévia de, no mínimo, 6 anos na área de Riscos, necessariamente em empresas reguladas pelo Banco Central do Brasil;
  4. Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações sobre Riscos do Banco Central do Brasil;

O que esperamos de você

  1. Capacidade de análise crítica, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  2. Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas da empresa e com órgãos reguladores;
  3. Boa comunicação e habilidade para elaboração de relatórios e apresentações;
  4. Proatividade na identificação e solução de problemas relacionados aos Riscos identificados;
  5. Capacidade de adaptar-se rapidamente a mudanças regulatórias e operacionais;
  6. Engajamento para criar e fortalecer de Riscos numa Instituição de Pagamento que acaba de ser criada;
  7. Conexão com o propósito da Swile - ao se aplicar, entenda mais sobre nosso propósito e se ele conversa com o seu.

Sobre nossos valores

  1. We are team players: nós nos importamos com nossos colegas e navegamos bem entre áreas;
  2. We are doers: temos ano nível de autonomia e entregamos resultados tangíveis;
  3. We move fast: identificamos corretamente as prioridades e assumimos a iniciativa;
  4. We are ambassadors: entendemos sobre o mercado, o produto e estamos alinhados em torno da mesma visão;
  5. We stay hungry: somos resilientes e gostamos de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  6. We cherish our values: abrimos mão do ego e aceitamos feedbacks como um presente.

O que oferecemos

  1. Pacote de benefícios flexíveis super atraentes para você usar como quiser (flexfood, mobilidade, cultura, educação, etc) dentro do cartão Swile;
  2. Remuneração variável;
  3. ️Plano de Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  4. TotalPass (acesso às melhores academias e estúdios);
  5. Saúde emocional (sessões de terapia gratuitas com um de nossos parceiros);
  6. Swile Shop (desconto em mais de 1.100 lojas e restaurantes);
  7. ️Aulas de inglês ou francês;
  8. Auxílio farmácia;
  9. Day off de aniversário;
  10. Auxílio Home-office;
  11. Auxílio Creche.

Nós abraçamos e incentivamos a diversidade e inclusão no nosso time, então, sinta-se livre para ser quem você é junto à nós.

description:
Role Overview

You’re the technical linchpin between our sales team and clients. As a GenAI Sales Architect, you’ll support discovery and solution-fit calls, shape compelling proposals, and ensure our GenAI offerings—across text, vision, and audio—align perfectly with client needs. Your deep expertise in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, and function-calling architectures will turn opportunities into robust, future-proof solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Support : Participate in client workshops and sales calls to uncover requirements, map business problems to GenAI use cases, and recommend architectures.

  • Solution Design: Architect end-to-end GenAI proposals leveraging:

    • RAG Pipelines: Embedding strategies, vector stores, dynamic retrieval flows.

    • Agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration for workflows, tool use and function calling.

    • Function-Calling: Designing safe, scalable function-execution patterns (e.g., retrieval, data enrichment, custom tool integrations).

    • Multimodal Components: Text generation & summarization, vision pipelines (OCR, image analysis), and audio services (speech-to-text, TTS, voice bots).

  • Proposal Development: Draft Statements of Work, high-level architecture diagrams, effort estimates, and risk/mitigation plans in collaboration with sales leadership.

  • Technical Evangelism: Deliver live demos and proof-of-concepts; distill complex AI concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for C-level and technical audiences.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work alongside global industry leaders to deliver and validate solution architectures, ensuring alignment with best practices and compliance standards.

  • Model Governance Advice: Recommend approaches for fine-tuning, bias mitigation, performance monitoring, and MLOps integration in client environments.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a pre-sales, solutions architect, or technical consulting role focused on generative AI.

  • Proven track record designing and pitching RAG-driven applications and agentic AI workflows.

  • Hands-on with function-calling patterns in LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, or similar).

  • Strong Python skills and experience integrating LLMs into production pipelines.

  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills;

Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating GenAI into enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, or SAP.

title: Product Design Team Lead
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: toprovide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

We are looking for a talented Technical Product Analyst who will be working on the management of our Payments portfolio in different regions and countries.

As a Technical Product Analyst for Payments, you will be pivotal in identifying, analyzing, and implementing strategies to elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of our payments platform. Your deep analytical skills will guide the continuous refinement and enhancement of our platform, ensuring it operates at peak performance and maintains operational excellence. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your expertise to drive continuous improvement and optimization of our platform's performance metrics.

Besides conquering the world, your activities will be:

  • Performance Analysis: Utilize advanced analytics to scrutinize platform performance data. Identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement that will drive strategic decisions to enhance system efficiency and reliability.
  • Drive Optimization Initiatives: Lead the charge in developing and implementing data-driven strategies for performance optimization. Collaborate with engineering and operations to ensure these initiatives successfully enhance platform capabilities and user satisfaction.
  • Market and Technology Trends Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging trends in payment technologies and industry best practices. Leverage this knowledge to recommend forward-thinking improvements and ensure the platform remains competitive and compliant with industry standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Work with business operations team to establish and maintain processes for ongoing performance monitoring and optimization, ensuring that performance goals are consistently met.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with different teams in the company to facilitate communication and alignment on priorities related to payments performance.
What’s mandatory:
  • Expertise in payments operations, fintech or a related industry;
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw actionable insights;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams;
  • A collaborative mindset, adept at working across various teams to achieve common goals;
  • A passion for continuous learning and improvement, with a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving;
What else would we like to see?
  • Ability to translate complex ideas into clear and intuitive product strategies;
  • Multilingual abilities, especially in markets relevant to the company - Portuguese, English, Spanish or Chinese Madarin;
  • Familiarity with tools and systems such as anti-fraud solutions, smart routing, data visualization/monitoring tools such as DataDog, Kibana and Grafana;
  • Teamwork: Collaborative ideation to find the most elegant solutions;
  • Legacy Respect: Learn from what works;
  • Pragmatism: Value results and practical solutions;
  • Quality First: Prioritize quality in every product decision.

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Birthday Day Off;
  • Semi-flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics stores, and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

Anstellungsdauer: 2 Jahre Vertrag, dann unbefristet

Aufgabenprofil

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen bereits im Kindergarten in zwei Kulturkreisen, was ihnen erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit ausgeschrieben. Neben der pädagogischen Tätigkeit wird die Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwartet.

Aufgaben

  • Arbeit in den Kindergartengruppen in deutscher Sprache (Deutsch ist Muttersprache!)
  • Teilnahme am Schulleben
  • aktive Beteiligung am Entwicklungsprozess des Kindergartens
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungen

Gesucht werden engagierte Erzieher/Erzieherinnen oder Kindheitspädagogen/Kindheitspädagoginnen, die Freude am Umgang mit Kindern im Alter von 2 bis 5 Jahren haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Wichtige Eigenschaften sind Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation, Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Kenntnisse in Portugiesisch sind kein Muss, werden aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses gefördert.

  • Ausbildung als ErzieherIn / KindheitspädagogIn
  • Berufserfahrung wünschenswert
  • hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier, Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit

Unser Angebot

Ein interessantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten Team. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt über dem Landesdurchschnitt. Zusätzlich gibt es Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung, Mietzuschuss sowie Umzugs- und Flugkostenpauschalen bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland.

Der Schulleiter, Thomas Duque Mand, freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: O Gerente Geral Comercial será responsável por liderar e gerenciar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, incluindo vendas internas, externas, revendas e parcerias. Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. O profissional deverá ter uma visão estratégica, orientada para a análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de novos canais e parcerias, e promover a evolução contínua das equipes sob sua gestão.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Gestão dos Canais de Vendas: Supervisionar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, garantindo que as metas de vendas sejam alcançadas em cada segmento (interno, externo, revendas, etc.).
• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.

• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.
• Suporte a Gerentes e Supervisores: Oferecer suporte contínuo aos gerentes de unidades e supervisores, fornecendo orientações, ferramentas e recursos necessários para o atingimento das metas comerciais.
• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.

3. Pacote Office avançado

title: Manager, Commercial Planning
description:
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  • Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  • Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  • Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  • Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  • Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  • Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  • Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  • Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  • Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  • Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  • Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  • Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  • Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  • Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  • Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  • High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  • Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

Please apply with a resume in English

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Team

The 1P Integrations Team is at the forefront of building and scaling a comprehensive suite of first-party eCommerce solutions. These include Online Ordering (websites, apps, kiosks), white-label logistics (Drive On Demand), customer support solutions, corporate ordering, merchant loyalty and rewards, and strategic marketplace partnership integrations. As part of a larger Platform Services organization, this team is poised to make a significant impact by helping hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas grow their businesses and improve their working lives in one of the country’s largest industry sectors.

About the Role

Frontend Engineers at DoorDash help design and build beautiful, intuitive user interfaces for our web applications to create the best delivery experience possible. Product focused Engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You’ll work with both technical and business teams to build features that keep our users top of mind.

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Become a product owner for one of our client facing applications.
  • Write robust, highly tested, well-crafted code that you can be proud of.
  • Fight for the best customer experience through technical and product decisions.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • B.S., M.S. or PhD in relevant field
  • 5+ years of industry experience
  • Experience architecting large-scale frontend applications
  • Mastery of the foundations of the web: vanilla JS, HTML5, CSS3
  • Deep understanding of REST principles and experience working with and implementing backend APIs
  • Experience with React/Redux, or similar frameworks

title: Talent Pool - Customer Success Manager
description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What's the opportunity?

As our Customer Success Manager, you’ll play a key role in building and nurturing strong relationships with our customers. You’ll be the trusted partner they rely on — guiding them, supporting them, and helping them get the most out of our solutions.

If you're a proactive and analytical professional who’s passionate about customer success and thrives in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you!

This is a Talent Pool for you to show your interest in being part of the Customer Success Team at dLocal as a Customer Success Manager. As soon as we have the right position for you, we will contact you!


What skills do I need?
  • Our ideal candidate is a good communicator, an excellent listener, self-motivated, a natural problem solver, and a great multitasker who can work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Fluent in written and verbal English.
  • Customer Success experience (B2B preferred).
  • Advanced analytical skills and familiarity with Excel/Looker/QuickSide/SQL.
  • Experience in payments - Huge advantage.
  • Background in Project Management or Customer Success Management with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding program goals.
  • Ability to travel.
  • Team spirit and proactive behavior.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

- Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*

- Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.

- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.

- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.

- Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.

- Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.

- Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!

- dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out ourwebpage ,Linkedin ,Instagram , andYoutube for more about dLocal!

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.
  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.
  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligence em direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders ,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders .
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders , gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento. Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Agente Stone em nosso manifesto.

  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

description:
The AWS Developer Experience team is seeking a Brazil Developer Community Manager; in this role you'll be at the heart of building and nurturing technical communities across Brazil. You’ll lead AWS User Groups, orchestrate AWS Community Day events, and develop innovative programs that help developers enhance their cloud skills. Your days will be diverse - from strategizing with community leaders and reviewing AWS Community Builders applications to collaborating on AWS Summit activities and participating in local meetups. You'll own the community advocacy strategy, measure its impact, and adapt programs based on community needs. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on community engagement to create lasting connections between AWS and passionate builders across Brazil.
Key job responsibilities
• Lead and execute the Brazil Community advocacy strategy, fostering engagement with developers and builders seeking to advance their AWS and cloud computing skills
• Drive growth of established community programs across Brazil, including AWS User Groups, AWS Community Builders, AWS Heroes, and AWS Community Day events, while developing innovative regional initiatives to meet local needs.
• Track program effectiveness through key metrics, provide regular updates to leadership, and adapt strategies to align with evolving community requirements and business objectives
A day in the life
Your day might start with a team standup to align on projects. You could then spend time developing a demo on AWS solutions, followed by writing a blog post. In the afternoon, you might prepare for a webinar, engage with the developer community on Stack Overflow, and explore new solutions. Your role combines technical expertise, content creation, and community engagement to inspire and educate developers.
About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years’ experience in developer relations and community management OR Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of relevant experience OR Completed Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience.
- Demonstrated success in managing technical communities and organizing developer-focused events, including meetups and conferences.
- Proven track record of leading multiple concurrent projects and delivering results in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to communicate effectively in English, within technical and business settings.
- Ability to travel throughout Brazil to support community initiatives and events.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of AWS services and cloud computing ecosystem
- Data analysis skills for tracking and interpreting community engagement metrics
- Established presence and network on developer-focused social media platforms
- Ability to communicate effectively in Spanish, within technical and business settings

title: Senior Credit Manager - Special Projects
description:
Do you know Bunge?

Distributed in more than 40 countries, a world leader in oilseed processing and one of the largest producers and suppliers of vegetable oils, fats, and proteins for more than two centuries, Bunge works to connect farmers to consumers to provide essential food, ingredients, and fuels for the world. With 117 years in Brazil, we have more than 100 units and are one of the main agribusiness and food companies, a leader in grain origination and soybean and wheat processing. In all our value chains, we promote our business while supporting the social and economic well-being of the communities where we operate.

We value the diversity of our teams and seek creative talents with team spirit and a desire to make a difference. In everything we do, we put our values into practice:
• Act as one team, promoting inclusion, collaboration, and respect;
• Seek excellence, being agile, innovative, and efficient;
• Do what is right, acting in a safe, ethical, and sustainable manner.

At Bunge, we value diversity in all its forms and work towards an inclusive and belonging culture with respect and equity. Here, everyone is welcome as they are!

Our company has a solid track record, and we are building a future full of opportunities! Be part of our team and follow your professional journey with us.

Summary:

This Senior Credit Manager – Special Projects position is a highly strategic role responsible for leading and executing complex credit-related initiatives within the organization. The incumbent will provide expert credit analysis and risk assessment for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), oversee credit management for Joint Venture partnerships, manage the credit application process of the company’s financial statement analysis application, and contribute to other special projects as needed. This role requires deep expertise in credit management, a strong understanding of Brazilian agribusiness, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate with senior management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Mergers & Acquisitions:
    • Conduct comprehensive due diligence and credit analysis on target companies.
    • Identify and quantify key credit risks and opportunities and participate in the structuring of credit solutions in M&A transactions.
    • Develop and present credit risk assessments and recommendations to senior management.
    • Support the integration of acquired companies into existing credit processes.
  • Joint Venture Partnerships:
    • Provide guidance for credit analysis and risk management practices for joint venture partnerships.
    • Develop and implement credit policies and procedures for joint ventures.
    • Monitor the credit performance of joint venture partners.
    • Provide guidance and training to joint venture partners on credit-related matters.
  • Financial Statement Analysis Application:
    • Manage the credit application process associated with the company’s financial statement analysis application.
    • Ensure the application effectively captures and analyzes relevant credit data.
    • Monitor the application’s performance and identify areas for improvement.
    • Collaborate with IT and other stakeholders on application development and maintenance.
  • Special Projects:
    • Contribute credit expertise to various special projects as they arise.
    • Provide credit risk assessments and recommendations for strategic initiatives.
    • Support the development and implementation of new credit products and services.
  • Leadership and Collaboration:
    • Interact effectively with executive-level managers, providing clear and concise credit information.
    • Collaborate with other leaders across commercial, finance, legal, and other departments.
    • Lead and mentor credit team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in credit management, including experience with M&A, joint ventures, and credit application processes.
  • Thorough understanding of the agricultural business and associated credit risks in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to manage, motivate, and mentor teams.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Proficiency in both Portuguese and English languages.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the needs of the organization. This job description is current as of 2025-06-03 and is subject to change.
